name: OVERKILL
desc:
⚡ Welcome to OVERKILL, a fast-paced multiplayer combat experience where every match is a chance to outplay your opponents, unlock exclusive rewards, and prove you're the best!

👑 Earn Crowns to unlock powerful weapons, epic finishers, and exclusive skins!
🏆 Earn your place among the top competitors and dominate the leaderboards.
✨ Collect rare cosmetics and customize your loadout to stand out from the competition!

💙 Like the game and join our group for exclusive rewards!
🎮 Available on Desktop, Mobile, Tablet, Xbox, & PlayStation!

⚠️ WARNING: Exploiting, cheating, glitch abuse, or unfair farming will result in a permanent ban. Our anti-cheat and moderation systems are always active.
